#| echo: false
#| message: false
library(DiagrammeR)

grViz("
digraph Databases {
  graph [rankdir = TB, fontsize = 12]
  
  # Global node settings
  node [fontname = Helvetica, fontcolor = black]
  
  # Main topic
  main [label = 'Databases & SQL', shape = box, style = filled, fillcolor = '#ADD8E6', fontsize = 14]
  
  # Core Concepts
  purpose [label = 'Purpose: Pull subsets\\nof data for local use', shape = ellipse]
  db_structure [label = 'Structure: Collection\\nof Data Frames', shape = ellipse]
  storage [label = 'Storage: Mostly by rows\\n(like JSON)', shape = ellipse]
  
  main -> purpose
  main -> db_structure
  main -> storage
  
  # The Interface Trio
  dbms [label = 'DBMS\\n(Software: DuckDB, MySQL)', shape = box, style = filled, fillcolor = '#90EE90']
  dbi [label = 'DBI\\n(Functions: dbConnect)', shape = box, style = filled, fillcolor = '#90EE90']
  dbplyr [label = 'dbplyr\\n(dplyr to SQL translation)', shape = box, style = filled, fillcolor = '#90EE90']
  
  main -> dbms
  main -> dbi
  main -> dbplyr
  
  # DBI Workflow
  connect [label = '1. dbConnect():\\nEstablish connection', shape = box, style = filled, fillcolor = '#FFFFE0']
  tbl_ref [label = '2. tbl():\\nAccess table lazily', shape = box, style = filled, fillcolor = '#FFFFE0']
  collect [label = '3. collect():\\nPull into local R memory', shape = box, style = filled, fillcolor = '#FFFFE0']
  
  dbi -> connect
  dbi -> tbl_ref
  dbi -> collect
  
  # SQL Logic
  sql_dialects [label = 'Multiple versions exist\\n(vary by DBMS)', shape = ellipse]
  sql_verbs [label = 'Key Verbs:\\nSELECT, FROM, WHERE', shape = ellipse]
  show_query [label = 'show_query():\\nSee generated SQL', shape = ellipse]
  
  dbplyr -> sql_dialects
  dbplyr -> sql_verbs
  dbplyr -> show_query
}
")
